# Plan A Technologies

> Award-winning software engineering, AI and design company. We design, build, modernize and run mission-critical software for startups and Fortune 500 companies. Global team, available 24/7/365, headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.

Plan A Technologies has helped organizations make their technology incredible for nearly 20 years. We combine old-school software craftsmanship with modern AI execution: award-winning custom development, integrations, migrations, rescue projects, platform modernization, and around-the-clock support — now delivered faster with AI agents alongside expert humans. We hire roughly 0.4% of applicants and have shipped 500+ products for 200+ clients.

## Services
- [AI Strategy & CTO Advisory](https://planatechnologies.com/services.html): senior guidance on enterprise AI transformation, roadmaps and risk.
- [Data & AI Foundations](https://planatechnologies.com/services.html): modern data infrastructure across AWS, Microsoft, Google, Databricks, OpenAI and Anthropic.
- [AI Agents & Intelligent Automation](https://planatechnologies.com/services.html): secure copilots, agentic workflows and enterprise automation.
- [Software Engineering & Modernization](https://planatechnologies.com/services.html): new builds, legacy overhauls, integrations and rescue projects.
- [24/7 Managed Technical Support](https://planatechnologies.com/services.html): veteran engineering coverage for systems that can't fail.

## Selected work
- The Palms — Gamified Offers: promotional game engine inside a casino resort's newsletter. +$32K/mo newsletter revenue, +14% open rate, +103% click-through to booking.
- Legacy Platform Re-Architecture (Financial Services): rebuilt a failing post-Flash transaction platform live in production; restored uptime, met new regulatory requirements, stopped client churn.
- Chronic Care Platform (Healthcare): secure, clinically-monitored patient community with real-time red-flag alerts to nurses and family.
- Field Dispatch Modernization (Blue Collar): multi-tenant dispatch platform rebuilt on .NET/React/React Native; 20x return via resale to new verticals.
- Tribal Citizen Portal (Government): one portal for voting, licensing, benefits and jobs; now being white-labeled for other tribal governments.
